data.title: Scholar Rock Announces FDA Approval of ISEMBYLD™ (apitegromab-mstn), the First and Only Muscle-Targeted Treatment for Children and Adults with Spinal Muscular Atrophy (SMA)
data.description: Scholar Rock, a biopharmaceutical company based in Cambridge, Massachusetts, has received FDA approval for ISEMBYLD (apitegromab-mstn) to treat spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) in adults and children over two years old who are already on SMN2-targeted therapy. This marks a significant advancement in addressing rare neuromuscular diseases, demonstrating the company's commitment to improving patient outcomes. With the approval, Scholar Rock aims to enhance the lives of individuals affected by SMA by leveraging its expertise in myostatin biology. The FDA's green light underscores the potential of ISEMBYLD as a viable treatment option for this debilitating condition, offering hope to patients and their families.

data.title: Treasure Trove Assembles the “Avengers of Collectibles” as Advisory Board
data.description: In New York, Treasure Trove, the collectibles holding company focused on creating the "Cultural Store of Value," revealed its advisory board, comprising industry powerhouses: Ken Goldin of Goldin, Jeremy Padawer, a passionate collector and investor, and Jim Halperin and Steve Ivy, the masterminds behind Heritage Auctions. Described as the "Avengers of the collectibles world" by AJ Scaramucci, Treasure Trove's founder, this lineup represents key figures in the field, each contributing vast expertise.

data.title: abrdn Healthcare Opportunities Fund (THQ) and abrdn World Healthcare Fund (THW) Announce New Managed Distribution Policies and Declare Monthly Distributions

data.title: Hydro One seeks approval from the Ontario Energy Board to build the North Shore Link
data.description: A new power line being constructed in northeast Toronto is anticipated to enhance the electricity system and boost economic development in the region. data.title: abrdn Global Premier Properties Fund (AWP) Announces New Managed Distribution Policy and Declares Monthly Distribution
data.description: Philadelphia, September 11, 2026 - The abrdn Global Premier Properties Fund (NYSE: AWP) disclosed that its Board of Trustees has endorsed a managed distribution policy to offer shareholders a clear distribution structure. data.title: University of Phoenix College of Doctoral Studies announces 2026 Knowledge Without Boundaries Summit
data.description: A two-day virtual research summit scheduled for October 22-23 will delve into the theme of "Research as Sense-Making in Times of Uncertainty." The event will unite scholars, practitioners, and community partners from various fields. Taking place in Phoenix, the summit is organized by the University of Phoenix College of Doctoral Studies. This marks the 13th edition of the event, which aims to foster collaboration and knowledge sharing among participants.

data.title: AstraZeneca Stock Trips On Unexpected Failure In Breast Cancer
data.description: A significant decline in AstraZeneca's stock was witnessed during late trades on Friday due to the failure of the company's experimental breast cancer treatment. The unexpected setback led to a substantial drop in the company's stock value. The unsuccessful trial outcome resulted in a visible stumble for AstraZeneca in the stock market, with investors reacting negatively to the news. This development had an impact on the company's financial standing, reflecting in the final trading numbers. The experimental breast cancer treatment not meeting the required standards had a pronounced effect on AstraZeneca's shares by the end of the trading day.

data.title: EverCommerce Announces an Increase and Extension of its Share Repurchase Program
data.description: Today, EverCommerce Inc. (NASDAQ: EVCM) based in Denver disclosed the approval from its Board of Directors for a $25 million expansion of its existing $300 million share buyback initiative. EverCommerce Inc. specializes in streamlining operations and fostering growth for small and medium-sized service businesses.

data.title: Maxim Power Corp. Announces TSX Acceptance of Normal Course Issuer Bid
data.description: On September 11, 2026, Maxim Power Corp. (TSX: MXG) disclosed approval from the Toronto Stock Exchange for a normal course issuer bid (NCIB), allowing the Corporation to buy back and cancel up to 3,173,127 common shares (Shares). With 63,462,546 Shares issued and outstanding as of September 2, 2026, the NCIB accounts for roughly 5% of MAXIM's total Shares by that date. The actual number of Shares eligible for repurchase and the buying schedule will be determined by MAXIM. The NCIB includes a daily limit of 2,389 Shares, representing 25% of MAXIM's average daily trading volume over the past six months, set at 9,557. Moreover, MAXIM can conduct one block purchase exceeding daily repurchase limits every calendar week.
